docs.span:
The Asciidoctor unconstrained-monospace shape (ruby#555): a
double-backtick span whose content may contain a SINGLE backtick.
The content guard is a negative lookahead over a MULTI-CHAR
SEQUENCE — `!( "`" "`" )` — not a single-char delimiter. The
lookahead's failure verdict must consult the whole sequence: a
reduction to its first literal (the 1.3.151-era bug) stops the
content at every backtick and the span can never close.

source:
## Semantics: L2
grammar ConformanceAdocMono version "1.0.0" edition "v2" {
  ## The Asciidoctor unconstrained-monospace shape (ruby#555): a
  ## double-backtick span whose content may contain a SINGLE backtick.
  ## The content guard is a negative lookahead over a MULTI-CHAR
  ## SEQUENCE — `!( "`" "`" )` — not a single-char delimiter. The
  ## lookahead's failure verdict must consult the whole sequence: a
  ## reduction to its first literal (the 1.3.151-era bug) stops the
  ## content at every backtick and the span can never close.
  span = ( "`" "`" ( 1* ( !( "`" "`" ) any_char ) ) as text "`" "`" ) as monospace_unconstrained
  document = *( span / any_char )

  any_char = %x01-10FFFF

  entry main: span
  entry doc: document

  test main {
    accept "`` ` ``"
    accept "`` a ``"
    accept "`` ``"
    reject "`` `"
    reject "```"
    reject "` `"
  }

  test doc {
    accept "x `` ` `` y"
    accept "`` ` `` x `` ` ``"
  }
}
